scope: Current signup feedback must identify what is wrong when the cause is known, rather than blanket signup-failed wording.

design_interpretation.field_issue: name affected field and specific reason, with correction guidance; preserve unaffected values
design_interpretation.connection_issue: describe known connection problem separately, do not label user data invalid
design_interpretation.unknown_cause: do not invent a field error or provider cause merely to sound specific
design_interpretation.account_policies: no new duplicate-email/phone/username policy or account-existence disclosure inferred
